request.subject: UNIT:DWARF:GUARD

layers.text: Change only the front: replace the round open front of the tub with one huge pointed cone-shaped drill bit of bright copper with dark spiral grooves, pointing forward to the lower right, as long as the tub. Keep the small signal-green lamp on the side, the soot-black iron tub, the tracks, the stack and its steam, the dwarf in the hatch, thick black outline and art style the same, on a transparent background.
